summary.text: John Pohlman is a Republican candidate for South Dakota House of Representatives District 10, a two-seat district with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary.
A Sioux Falls resident who works in marketing, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a business owner focused on affordability, public safety and economic development.

paragraphs.text: John Pohlman graduated from T.F. Riggs High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Dakota in 1984.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he and his wife, Stacey, are natives of Pierre who have lived in Sioux Falls since 1984, and that they raised three daughters in District 10.
He said he has built a career as a business owner and leader and has worked with state and community leaders on economic development, public safety, education funding, and other issues.

Pohlman listed affordability, public safety and a practical approach to state government as his key campaign messages, including keeping taxes low and breaking the cycle of prison recidivism through education and vocational training.
He named economic development as the area of public policy he is most passionate about.
